summary: Lexington School District urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate funding to maintain essential broadband infrastructure for schools and libraries.

claims.argument: Lexington School District 7 would be forced to divert critical instructional funds to maintain the essential network equipment and wireless access points required for daily digital learning
claims.evidence_quote: Without this federal support, our district would be forced to divert critical instructional funds to maintain the essential network equipment and wireless access points required for daily digital learning.
